message.content: Now let me look at the build infrastructure to understand how to compile and test:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	pushd oniguruma
     2	autoreconf -vfi
     3	./configure
     4	make -j$(nproc)
     5	popd
     6	export ONIG_CFLAGS="-I$PWD/oniguruma/src"
     7	export ONIG_LIBS="-L$PWD/oniguruma/src/.libs -l:libonig.a"
     8	export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fno-sanitize=object-size"
     9	export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fno-sanitize=object-size"
    10	./buildconf
    11	./configure     --disable-all     --enable-option-checking=fatal     --enable-fuzzer     --enable-json     --enable-exif     --enable-mbstring     --without-pcre-jit     --disable-phpdbg     --disable-cgi     --with-pic
    12	make -j$(nproc)
    13	sapi/cli/php sapi/fuzzer/generate_unserialize_dict.php
    14	cp sapi/fuzzer/dict/unserialize $OUT/php-fuzz-unserialize.dict
    15	sapi/cli/php sapi/fuzzer/generate_parser_corpus.php
    16	cp sapi/fuzzer/dict/parser $OUT/php-fuzz-parser.dict
    17	cp sapi/fuzzer/json.dict $OUT/php-fuzz-json.dict
    18	FUZZERS="php-fuzz-json php-fuzz-exif php-fuzz-mbstring php-fuzz-unserialize php-fuzz-parser"
    19	for fuzzerName in $FUZZERS; do
    20	        cp sapi/fuzzer/$fuzzerName $OUT/
    21	done
    22	for fuzzerName in `ls sapi/fuzzer/corpus`; do
    23	        zip -j $OUT/php-fuzz-${fuzzerName}_seed_corpus.zip sapi/fuzzer/corpus/${fuzzerName}/*
    24	done
